recovery_notes.reason: Filesystem execution failed with ENOSPC and then exec-server os error 2 after the source edits below. Recovered from executed apply_patch tool history; no filesystem read was possible.

Header variants desktop render correctly, but styles.xml violates exact ODF master-page child order.
Four added header child-order regression tests all failed before repair.
After header repair, 31 tests in header-order/header-fidelity/document-writer suites passed.

Scratch A/B: repacked control fails; height 35->80 pt alone fails; text:anchor-page-number=1 alone fails; paragraph wrapper with page-relative graphic style succeeds.
New nonleading frame regression failed before its repair.
After frame source repair dart format reported zero changes; the test process could not create its temp directory because ENOSPC. No post-frame passing tests claimed.
